decision.reason: [ev-fe0fca386a7a] says plainly that 1.17.0 adds a new Helm value `webhook.extraEnv` for custom environment variables in the webhook Pod. However, it bundles this with two other new values (`cainjector.extraEnv`, `startupapicheck.extraEnv`). The values-file validator also refuted "added": it reports that `webhook.extraEnv` already exists in the v1.16.0 chart values [ev-fdc96eee87bf], as well as in v1.17.0 [ev-717ddb6f40cd]. The artifact excerpts shown only contain a section header, so they don't settle whether the key existed before or what changed. We need the relevant v1.16.0 and v1.17.0 values.yaml contents (or PR #7317) before writing the change type and consequence.
